name: Asino Altiele
original_name: アーシノ・アルティエーレ
source:
Chris' best and only male friend, he supports Chris from the side and seems to be very popular with girls.

[spoiler]He had originally planned to partner with Falsita, but it is later revealed that she was only using him to obtain information about Chris and dumped him soon after.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Symphonic_Rain]Wikipedia[/url]]
